description: This PHP class 'ReviewListController' extends 'ReviewSearchController' and is responsible for handling review list-related operations in the Human Resource Management system's performance module. It primarily sets up a Vue component for rendering the review list with date properties.

classes.name: ReviewListController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for preparing the review list view, including setting up the associated Vue component.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the review list view by initializing the Vue component with date range properties before rendering.
